name: Ten of Wands
meaning_for_today: Today may feel heavy with responsibilities and obligations. Although the burden is great, persistence and discipline will help you complete what you started.
card_advice: Do not carry everything alone. Learn to prioritize, delegate responsibilities, and avoid exhausting yourself with unnecessary pressure.

upright.general: The Ten of Wands represents overwhelming duties, stress, and the weight of obligations. It often appears when success has brought additional responsibilities that drain physical or emotional energy.
upright.in_love: Relationships may feel weighed down by emotional pressure, obligations, or unresolved issues. One partner may feel overburdened or emotionally exhausted.
upright.in_situation: The situation demands endurance and responsibility. Although progress is possible, too many commitments or expectations may create strain and exhaustion.

reversed.short: Relief, release, burnout, inability to cope.
reversed.general: The reversed Ten of Wands points to releasing burdens, delegating responsibilities, or reaching the limit of emotional and physical endurance. It may also indicate avoidance of duties.
reversed.in_love: Emotional pressure begins to ease, or one partner withdraws from responsibilities within the relationship. Unspoken stress may finally surface.
reversed.in_situation: The situation improves when unnecessary burdens are removed. It is important to recognize personal limits and seek support where needed.

major.01: A difficult new journey with heavy responsibilities.
major.06: Obligations connected to traditions or rules.
major.10: A period of reflection is needed for recovery.
major.13: A pause or sacrifice before relief arrives.
major.14: Transformation through hard work and struggle.
major.16: Attachments and fears create extra burdens.
major.22: Completion and fulfillment after carrying heavy loads.

cups.01: Emotional burdens connected to new feelings.
cups.07: Too many emotional choices create stress.

pentacles.04: Fear of losing stability increases pressure.
pentacles.06: Support from others helps reduce stress.
pentacles.07: Patience is tested by slow progress.
pentacles.10: Family and financial obligations become overwhelming.

swords.04: Rest and recovery are urgently needed.
swords.10: A painful ending after prolonged struggle.

wands.01: A new opportunity carries major responsibilities.
wands.04: Responsibilities connected to family or celebration.
wands.10: Double emphasis on burden and responsibility.
